payload.description: Turn image generation into a repeatable studio: batches, agent-refined prompts, iteration history and likes. Image Studio groups image work into named workstreams. Choose any compatible ComfyUI workflow through RedLeaf's entity picker, edit its declared parameters, generate up to 24 variations, compare them, like or dislike outputs and branch a new run from an earlier one. Optional prompt refinement delegates one bounded editing task to a selected RedLeaf Agent using that Agent's configured provider and quality tier.
